claims: Tulum is located on Mexico's Caribbean coast in Quintana Roo.
Tulum is split into the beachside hotel zone and the more affordable town center.
As of early 2026, Tulum is experiencing lower prices.
As of early 2026, Tulum is experiencing a quieter, more relaxed atmosphere.
Tulum experienced a downturn in tourism.
Tulum Archaeological Zone consists of pre-Columbian Mayan ruins overlooking the sea.
Tulum Archaeological Zone was formerly a major port.
Some Tulum beaches are now part of the protected Parque del Jaguar.
Parque del Jaguar requires an entrance fee.
Some Tulum beaches are private beach clubs.
Punta Laguna Nature Reserve is for wildlife viewing.
Tulum nightlife includes Papaya Playa Project, Gitano, and Casa Jaguar.
Significant sargassum can appear on Tulum beaches between April and October.
